instructions.local_testing:
1. Start mock backend: node mock-backend-server.js
2. Set environment to 'local'
3. Run: npm run build
4. Load extension in Chrome
instructions.production:
1. Deploy website auth pages to q-sci.org
2. Deploy backend API endpoints
3. Set environment to 'production'
4. Update clerkPublishableKey
5. Run: npm run build
6. Package and distribute extension
